mechanism: Both drugs have anticholinergic and CNS depressant properties; tetrabenazine causes dopamine depletion which may worsen meclizine's anticholinergic effects and increase sedation/dizziness risk.
action: Monitor for excessive sedation, dizziness, anticholinergic symptoms, and balance impairment; consider alternative antiemetic if clinically feasible or use lowest effective doses with patient counseling on fall risk.
